provenance: Enumerated from RI-JRN05 §B, which is binding. This file is the SPECIFICATION; game/src/save/state.js is the implementation. RI-JRN05 M4 is a set-difference in BOTH directions between this file and the key set of canonicalise(saveState()) — a field in the save that is not here is a defect, and a field here that is not in the save is a defect.

rules.V1: The volatile list is CLOSED. A field that differs across a round trip and is not on it is a defect. Moving a field onto it to make a test pass is falsification under RI-MTH04, not a fix.

groups.note: W1-07: identity.creation.* is the Writ House record — RI-CHR01 §7 marks six of its eight fields permanently irreversible, so the save is where irreversibility is actually enforced.
Every skill's current value AND its accumulated use-progress fraction (RI-JRN05 §B) — character.skills entries are {value, use_progress}.
Each stack: id, count, condition, charge, stolen, owner_of_record, equipped_slot, quick_slot. Sorted by id.

Seam S19. `magic.custom_spells` is the one that matters: RI-MAG03 M1 requires a commissioned spell to appear in saveState(), because a spellmaking system whose output does not survive a save is a preview, not a system. `magic.focus` is durable and is NOT restored to full on load — RI-MAG01 §A allows exactly two things to raise it and loading is not one of them.
Per quest: stage, branch, failed, giver_disposition_delta, time_limit_in_frames, flags{}.
Append-only; order is SEMANTIC and indices are stable (journal.entry.numbering / RI-DLG05). Renumbering or reordering across a round trip is RI-JRN05 HF7.

Witness IDENTITIES, not a count — RI-JRN05 M8 and 'How we lose' #4. W1-15 round 2 added `crime.ledger` and `crime.zones`: the four lists above are id PROJECTIONS of a ledger that has to survive a save whole — the crime records with their quotes and jurisdictions (RI-CRM01 §1), the stolen rows with their owners and values (RI-STL02 §2), and seam S-4's per-zone baseline alert, which RI-STL01 §7 requires to survive 'leaving and re-entering the zone, death, and save/load'. Round 1 shipped the four lists and never wrote to them.

entity_fields_declared_absent.hitboxes: An entity's own hitboxes are produced by an attack, and no wave-1 archetype attacks (ai is 'none' or 'hold_ground'), so the array is empty on every frame this build can produce and serialising it would be untested code. getDurableFieldCensus() ASSERTS it is empty instead, and the assertion fails loudly the moment W1-06 gives an enemy a swing.

groups.note: world.entities is ONE manifest path (an array leaf), so RI-JRN05 M4's path-level set difference cannot see inside it. That is how GAP-W1-platform-save-drops-entity-prev-state survived a verdict: prev_state was in the frame record and in the live entity and in no save, and no instrument compared those three key sets. entity_record_fields is the field-level declaration, and __HARNESS.getDurableFieldCensus() -- run by tools/harness/save-audit.mjs -- does the set difference in BOTH directions against the LIVE entity object: every own key of a live entity must appear in exactly one of entity_record_fields, entity_fields_derived_from_the_archetype or entity_fields_declared_absent, and every declared record field must be present in the save.

Existence, position, soul quantity and which death it belongs to. Semantics are RI-JRN06's; survival across a save is this item's. `death.bloodstain` is a nullable RECORD and is therefore a declared dynamic container in rules.dynamic_containers: the manifest set-difference stops at it rather than treating its three fields as three separate manifest entries that vanish whenever there is no bloodstain.

Animation timers are stored as FRAME-RELATIVE offsets, because the current frame index is declared volatile. Storing absolute frame indices would make the round-trip hash depend on when you saved. move_dir_deg and speed_mps persist ACROSS frames rather than being recomputed on each one (move_dir_deg is written only while moving; speed_mps is skipped by the hitstop early-return), and both are in the frame record, so they are durable for the same reason enemies[].prev_state is. camera_shake_amp_deg / camera_shake_in_frames are the two shake state words the per-frame shake is re-derived from; camera.override is HARNESS-SCOPED, not player state, and loadState clears it deliberately.
The seed AND the draw counter. A load that resets the draw counter is a determinism break (HARNESS.md D5) and is RI-JRN05 M5 / HF1.
CLOSED. Nothing may be added without an amendment to RI-JRN05.

declared_incomplete.note: Groups whose OWNING SYSTEM does not exist in wave 1 are present here and in the save as real, empty, round-tripping containers — not omitted. quests{} is empty because no quest runtime exists (owner: wave-1 pieces W1-14..W1-16), not because quest state is unsaved. RI-JRN05's five scenarios SV1-SV5 exercise late-game state; game/data/states/ ships sv1 and sv5 as fixtures so the round trip is measured against non-trivial state rather than a fresh character (RI-JRN05 'How we lose' #14).
